# AI Productivity Workflows — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Meeting → actions → follow-ups

*Module 1: Meetings and email · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_meeting_to_followups.py`): Paste the notes of your last real meeting (names changed) into data/meeting.txt and re-run. Which actions had no date? Fix the meeting habit, not the tool.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Report from raw notes

*Module 2: Documents and spreadsheets · about 36 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_notes_to_report.py`): Add a field to SPEC (for example 'Headcount') and a sentence to the notes. Then deliberately change one number in the report and watch the verifier catch it.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Vendor comparison brief

*Module 3: Research and decisions · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_vendor_comparison.py`): Replace the three vendors and criteria with a real decision you face. Does the winner change when you double the weight of your biggest worry?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Save 5 workflows

*Module 4: Your personal system · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_prompt_library.py`): Write five prompts for your own week in data/prompts.yaml format. Aim for 4/4 on each. Share the best one with the room.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
